title: Cover and Contact
author: Ivo Winterbourne
blurb: Coral Brightwater, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
